name: Resort
summary: Destination resort (upper-upscale to luxury) with multiple pools, spa, several F&B outlets, recreation and extensive landscaped grounds, typically low-rise on a large site. Per-key cost is driven by amenity area per key, villa/casita share and remote-site logistics, so the range is very wide. No survey reports resorts separately; the default is derived from HVS full-service and luxury per-key building costs (luxury includes many resorts) and RLB 5-star $/SF.

typicalSize.method: HCEG luxury prototype 200 rooms + 20 suites (e19); destination resorts range ~100–600+ keys (integrated/convention resorts larger). Mid 300 is a judgment.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Net guestrooms 472–578 SF (HCEG upper upscale / luxury, e20) + bath ~100 SF → ~600–700 SF; ~0.65 efficiency → ~900–1,050 GSF/key for guestroom wings; spa, multiple F&B, meeting and large BOH add ~300–1,500 SF/key. Mid 1,600.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Low-density grounds with pools, gardens and recreation; golf/ranch resorts below 5 keys/acre are possible (golf course excluded here).

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Fly-in destination resorts with shuttles need ~0.5; drive-to resorts with group business ~1.0–1.3.

perPrimaryUnit.method: HVS building & site improvements per key (median / average). Luxury: 2025 data $916,919 / $1,261,653 (e1); 2024 data $620,471 / $799,766 (e2); 2023 data $650,636 / $690,314 (e3); 2021–22 data $500,059 / $495,059 (e4). Full-service 2025 data average $374,355 (e5). A typical upper-upscale-to-luxury destination resort sits between the full-service average and the luxury median: midpoint of $374k and the 2024–2025-data luxury medians (~$620k–$917k) ≈ $580k–$645k, x0.91 (HVS includes permits/engineering/contingency) ≈ $530k–$590k → mid $550k. Low $350k ≈ 0.91 x full-service average plus resort amenity premium; high $1.1M ≈ 0.91 x 2025-data luxury average ($1.15M). Cross-check: RLB 2026 metro 5-star median midpoint $613/SF (e6) x 1,600 SF ≈ $980k in large metros (resorts are mostly non-metro, lower per SF but more SF per key). 2023 and earlier luxury figures (2021–2023 data) shown for spread only.

perSF.method: Mid = $550k ÷ 1,600 SF ≈ $344/SF; low ≈ $350k ÷ 1,250; high ≈ RLB 2026 metro 5-star median midpoint $613 (e6).

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC and OH&P; includes on-site roads, resort pools and pool decks, landscaping/hardscape and site utilities within the property line. Excludes land, golf course, marina, off-site roads/utility extensions, FF&E/OS&E, soft costs, pre-opening, permits, contingency, impact/tap fees and financing.

qualityTiers.method: Economy = low/mid (0.64, a modest upscale resort; rounded to 0.7); premium 1.4; luxury = high/mid (2.0).

systemSplit.method: Derived from the full-service split, shifting ~10 pts toward pools/water features (13, 4%), landscape/hardscape (32, 5%), earthwork (31) and site utilities (33) for a low-rise campus, with fewer elevators (14). No public resort elemental estimate was found.

lineItems.name: Pre-opening, OS&E and working capital

cost.method: HVS pre-opening & working capital per key: luxury 2025 data $20,292 median / $19,674 avg (e13), 2024 data $28,639 / $24,855 (e14); full-service 2025 data $11,842 / $14,075 (e15). Mid = luxury 2025-data median.

lineItems.notes: Owner cost: pre-opening staffing/housing, OS&E (spa, F&B, recreation supplies), marketing, operating reserves, technical services.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Between HVS full-service FF&E ($36,752 median / $43,928 avg, 2025 data, e9) and luxury ($138,317 median / $118,359 avg 2025 data, e7; $94,613 / $96,752 2024 data, e8); mid $60k for an upper-upscale resort with spa and multiple outlets.

pctOfHard.method: HVS soft ÷ building & site improvements (medians): luxury 2024 data 153,957/620,471 = 24.8% (e11), 2025 data 371,645/916,919 = 40.5% (e10); full-service 2025 data 22.6% (e12). HVS soft costs include financing (long resort schedules make it large); excluding it, mid 22% with high 30%.

softCosts.notes: Includes master planning, landscape architecture, spa/F&B/pool consultants, environmental and entitlement studies, operator technical services, legal, insurance and permits. Developer fee and financing handled separately.

design.method: Custom, amenity-heavy programs evolve through design.

hard.method: Large sites with geotechnical/utility and remote-logistics risk.

perPrimaryUnit.method: HVS all-in total less land: full-service 2025 data ≈ $437k median / $526k average (e18); luxury 2024 data $1,057,494 − $116,782 ≈ $941k median (e17); luxury 2025 data $1,604,356 − $129,935 ≈ $1.47M median, $1,961,964 − $223,916 ≈ $1.74M average (e16). HVS notes many luxury projects exceed $2M per room all-in.

openQuestions: No resort-specific public cost data was collected (search budget exhausted): a public resort budget (e.g., tribal/state-park lodge or TIF-supported resort) would anchor the hard cost and amenity line items (pools, spa, golf).
Amenity line items (resort pool complex, spa per SF, villas) are not itemized; consider adding sourced building blocks.
